detail.longDescription: ⚕️ This study is the first to describe a possible association between plastic particles and kidney stones, It is not known whether it is really microplastics that promote the formation of stones or if microplastics, because they have been filtered by the kidney, are incorporated into the stone while it is formed,” # Medical # Health # Research https://www. lapresse.ca/actualites/science s/2026-11-27/etude/association-entre-microplastiques-et-calculs-renaux.php
